assessment: This fundamental work advances our understanding of bone marrow adipogenic lineage precursors as a major source of Csf1 in bone and important regulator of bone remodeling. The evidence supporting the conclusion is compelling, using Adipoq-Cre-based conditional deletion of Csf1 and scRNA-seq approaches. This paper is of potential interest to scientists who study bone marrow stem/progenitor cells, bone remodeling, and metabolism.
